mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings on diesel trucks. Titled as a warning to other builders, which makes it the highest-visibility negative thread in this set.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King main bearings from 2024 production are out of spec on free spread, and says 2025 production mains had the same problem. A repeat-across-model-years quality claim, not a one-off.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch timed out after 60 seconds; thread content could not be read this run, so the previously recorded King reply could not be re-confirmed.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Multiple independent builders in one thread: a BMW shop found King STDX thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow across several S85/S65 blocks and concluded King bearings 'cannot be trusted period'; others report defective SI shells and machining shavings in the packaging.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no King or official brand representative has replied and it remains open and unresolved.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer reports an XP-series package with the wrong mix of sizes (8 upper .011, 7 lower .011, 1 lower .030) and complains specifically about the lack of support in getting it resolved. Service complaint on top of a product complaint.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: BMW M5 owner thread titled as a flat defect claim on King main bearings. Credible single-source complaint about a real product fault.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder received a King SI bi-metal main bearing shell crushed and twisted in production so badly it would not fit the crank, plus rod bearings packaged with bearing shavings and oil.
mentions.replyNote: Thread read successfully; no official King representative has responded and it remains open and unresolved.
